$comment: The KernelSU late-load build this target pairs with. CI rebuilds it from
the src/kernelsu submodule; nothing is committed as a binary.
'id' names the published assets (ksud-<id>, kernelsu-<id>.ko). Targets that
load the same module share one id and are built once, so two of them must
describe that module identically or ask for separate ids.
'kernelRelease' is the exact UTS release the module must report in its
vermagic. The DDK image ships its own release string, so the build
overwrites the generated utsrelease.h and kernel.release with this value
'patchSets' names the patch sets this build takes on top of common, as
directories under the patch submodule's patches/<version>/ -- a vendor set
such as 'galaxy', or 'devices/<id>' for something only this module can
use. The version is derived from the KernelSU submodule pin and named by
no target, so none can ask for one upstream revision while the tree is at
another. PMG110 takes none: ColorOS 16 has no KDP/RKP/DEFEX, so it builds
against a tree carrying only common, whose staged late-load the bootstrap
'config' is passed to the module build as-is. It gates code inside a patch
set, so it goes with one: with no set named here there is nothing to gate.
